name: Rosewood Bermuda
insider_take: This ultra-luxury clifftop retreat sits on Tucker's Point, where pink sand beaches meet turquoise waters and the dramatic coastline has inspired artists for centuries.
whats_special: Rosewood Bermuda occupies a pristine 240-acre peninsula with two championship golf courses designed by Roger Rulewich. The property features Bermuda's only cliff-edge infinity pool and sits atop 60-foot limestone bluffs. The hotel's signature restaurant sources ingredients from its own organic garden, while the spa incorporates indigenous Bermuda cedar and local sea salt into treatments.
pro_tip: Book a sunrise yoga session on the clifftop terrace - you'll have unobstructed views of Castle Harbour while practically no other guests are awake to disturb the serene atmosphere.
dont_miss: The nearby Crystal Caves, a stunning underground wonderland of stalactites and stalagmites discovered in 1907, is just 10 minutes away. Also explore the historic town of St. George's, a UNESCO World Heritage site founded in 1609, featuring the oldest continuously inhabited English settlement in the New World with colorful colonial architecture and the famous Unfinished Church ruins.
pros: Stunning oceanfront location with private beach access
Ultra-luxurious accommodations with spacious suites and premium amenities
Exceptional fine dining restaurants with ocean views
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects ultra-high-end positioning
Remote island location requires flight connections
